name: bus-arrival-tracker
description: Sound Transit real-time bus and light rail arrival tracker using GTFS-RT

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init 'ST Tracker' com.maxluo.sttracker --web-dir www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release
